# TopCheckouts

> We reverse-look-up referral data for 9 checkouts (Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy and more) to rank 607 websites by how many visits reach their payment page each month, and classify where their new users come from: SEO, GEO, social, viral or other. Data for September 2026.

TopCheckouts ranks independent websites by monthly visits that reach their checkout/payment page (Stripe Checkout, Stripe Payment Links, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Creem, Whop), estimated from Similarweb referral data for September 2026, and classifies each site's main new-user source into one of five classes: SEO (non-brand search), GEO (AI assistants), Social media, Viral (built-in sharing) and Other.

Key facts:
- 607 websites selected from 15,790 that referred traffic to 9 checkout domains.
- Filters: ≥3,000 checkout visits in Sep 2026; >50% paid traffic removed; big brands, funded startups, enterprise B2B, marketplaces and affiliate-driven tools removed.
- Checkout visits are visits, not payments or revenue.
- Every site has its own page with checkout visits, growth vs Apr–Jun, website visits, traffic source mix, new-user source, keywords, AI referrals and pricing.

## Pages
- [Rankings (English)](https://topcheckouts.000ooo.ooo/en/): all 607 sites, tabs by new-user source
- [排行榜（中文）](https://topcheckouts.000ooo.ooo/): 中文版
